Tooling reminders (still accurate this wake): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys. The claims ledger's field for claim text is 'text', NOT 'claim'. THE CLAIMS LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/claims_ledger.jsonl (not claims.jsonl -- the current_state.json snapshot of ledger_heads.claims can lag the actual file's tail seq; trust the file, not the snapshot). THE EVIDENCE LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl. THE DECISION LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/decision_log.jsonl (secre-record's ledger-name argument is still 'decisions'). harness.citations.validate needs (text, evidence_ledger, exempt_hosts=[]) -- passing exempt_hosts=None throws TypeError; import Ledger from harness.ledger and construct Ledger(Path(...)) directly. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. Always add explicit inline <https://...> citations in the prose itself (front-matter JSON URLs alone are invisible to citations.validate, which only scans the body) -- confirmed again this wake: had to add one inline citation after an initial validate() call returned zero cited URLs despite the source being in front matter and prose (without angle brackets).
